name: Alpenresort Schwarz
beschreibung: The Alpenresort Schwarz in Mieming, Tyrol, is situated on the Mieming Plateau with panoramic mountain views. The accommodation offers rooms and suites, some of which feature private balconies. The wellness area includes an indoor pool, saunas, and relaxation rooms. The dining experience focuses on seasonal and local produce. Guests use the hotel as a base for hiking, cycling tours, and winter sports. The resort is designed for peaceful recreation and also provides dedicated amenities for children. Families and couples alike will find an ideal setting. Its location also allows for convenient day trips to Innsbruck or the Ötztal Valley.
